$comment: Machine-readable record of what Humanity Ledger has deployed on Aztec testnet. Checked against the live node by .github/workflows/aztec-deployments.yml (test/live/aztec-deployments.live.test.ts). docs/AZTEC_TESTNET_DEPLOYMENTS.md is the human-readable version of this file.

contracts.name: IdentityCredential
contracts.note: Deployed with placeholder roots (identity 0x12345678, sanctions 0x87654321): no member can claim until the issuer sets a real identity root.

contracts.name: PrivateEscrow
contracts.note: Deployed without public keys. Tokens deposited here become notes owned by a contract that has no nullifier key, so no PXE can ever spend them: deposits would be locked. Escrows must use a keyed instance (scripts/aztec/deploy-keyed.ts).

contracts.name: PaymentStream
contracts.note: Deployed without public keys; same consequence as the PrivateEscrow instance above. Streams must use a keyed instance.
